label: preliminary, container on a dev machine
purpose: Deviation D4 of the X1a classifier rules: programs of the agree set that print wall-clock times or unseeded random values (or otherwise have no stable zero-pass observation). classify.py does not judge them (reference class EXCLUDED); corpus.py marks them. The determinism check on the zero-pass repeats stays as a second line of defence and reports programs it catches that are not listed here.

criteria.a: The zero-pass repeats of the program differed in the first run (records of Camel 623f5145, 13 programs) or in the after-run (records of Camel 0586a0a6, 16 entries of 13 files), under the frozen determinism check (CLASSIFIER-RULES.md section 5).
criteria.b: Source review. Candidates were every program whose archived zero-pass trace contains an operator matching ^time:|rand|random, or whose source imports time, random, os or perf, or calls now(, random(, rand*(, seed(, sleep(. A candidate is excluded when a clock value or a random value drawn before any seed operator reaches the printed output, a written file, an effect payload or the exit code. The review was done by the harness maintainer (an AI agent) by reading each source file; it was not checked by a second reader.
criteria.c: Source review: the program observes by design whether calls with no order between them run at the same time, or in which order they do. Its output (or its effect trace) on a pipeline ending in the parallel scheduler differs from the default run without either being wrong, so pipeline invariance against the default run does not apply to it. Its own test (test/plans/feat/para/core.plan.toml) asserts the expected values under std::prl.
criteria.d: Retired: design principles 5.10 removed `any`, so no program is excluded by this criterion any more. Owner ruling (2026-10-07): the program prints a value whose static type is `any`. Camel has no run-time type test, so such a value prints as `<any>`; a pass that inlines the call makes the static type of the printed value known and it then prints as that type. Both outputs are by design (printing `<any>` is the safest behaviour for a value of unknown type), so the output of a pipeline that inlines differs from the default run without either being wrong, and pipeline invariance against the default run does not apply to the program.

how_to_extend: Add an entry with path (relative to the repository root, all environment variants of the file are excluded), reason, criteria and evidence. A program that runs clock/random operators and stays judged goes into reviewed_not_excluded with the reason; classify.py reports programs with such operators that are in neither list.
